$meta.description: Block agent read, write, edit, or bash access to protected files (secrets, credentials, env configs). Adapted from the Anthropic Claude hooks article example.
notes: Also guards Bash tool to catch cat .env, grep through secrets, etc.
Extend PROTECTED_PATTERNS in protect-files.sh to add project-specific secrets.
Decision is 'deny' (hard block) — change to 'ask' in the script to prompt instead.
